name: Clutch bag
definition: small handle-less bag carried in the hand or under the arm.
notes: Clutch bags 246 at Selfridges; Wikipedia lists clutch as a handbag type.

name: Minaudière
definition: small rigid, often ornamented evening case carried in the hand.
notes: Wikipedia Handbag lists minaudiere as a handbag type; no shop page found.

name: Wristlet bag
definition: small bag with a wrist strap and its own interior compartment (homonym with A4.5.12).
notes: Wikipedia Handbag lists wristlet; page does not say whether an interior compartment is present.

name: Tote bag
definition: open-topped bag with two parallel handles and an unstructured body.
notes: Tote bags 410 at Selfridges; Wikipedia lists tote.

name: Satchel
definition: structured bag with a flap front, usually with top handles and a shoulder strap.
notes: Satchel listed by Wikipedia; Selfridges sells Valentino Rockstud crossbody satchel.

name: Top-handle bag
definition: structured bag carried mainly by one or two short handles on top.
notes: Top handle bags 483 at Selfridges; Wikipedia lists top handle bag.

name: Shoulder bag
definition: bag on a single strap worn on one shoulder.
notes: Shoulder bags 827 at Selfridges; Wikipedia lists shoulder bag.

name: Crossbody bag
definition: bag with a soft body and no front flap, on a strap worn across the body.
notes: Cross body bags 301 at Selfridges; Wikipedia lists crossbody bag.

name: Messenger bag
definition: crossbody bag with a full front flap and a wide gusset.
notes: Wikipedia lists messenger bag; Freitag messenger shown. Full-flap and gusset not stated.

name: Sling bag
definition: single-strap pack worn on the back or chest.
notes: Sling bags and sling packs sold as a category; worn over one shoulder and across the body.

name: Hobo bag
definition: slouchy crescent-shaped bag on a single shoulder strap.
notes: Wikipedia lists hobo bag; Selfridges sells Chloe Marcie hobo bag.

name: Bucket bag
definition: bucket-shaped bag with a round or oval base, closed by a drawstring or open top.
notes: Bucket bags 53 at Selfridges; Wikipedia lists bucket bag.

name: Baguette bag
definition: small, long, narrow bag carried close under the arm on a short strap.
notes: Wikipedia lists baguette; Bags (fashion) category has a Baguette (bag) page.

name: Saddle bag
definition: bag shaped like a rider's saddlebag, with a curved body and front flap.
notes: Wikipedia lists saddlebag; Dior Saddle bag introduced 1999.

name: Daypack
definition: general backpack sized for one day's personal items.
notes: Daypack described as one main compartment, basic straps; also used for school.

name: Laptop backpack
definition: backpack built around a padded laptop compartment.
notes: Laptop backpacks sold as own category (Samsonite Laptop Backpacks); padded laptop sleeve.

name: Hiking backpack
definition: backpack with a load-bearing harness and hip belt for walking on trails.
notes: Hiking backpacks with hip belts and load control; frameless and internal-frame.

name: Carry-on travel backpack
definition: backpack sized to airline cabin limits that opens like a suitcase.
notes: Carry-on travel backpack 30-45 L with clamshell opening; Samsonite Travel Backpacks category.

name: Belt bag (bum bag)
definition: small bag worn on a belt round the waist or across the chest.
notes: Belt bags category at Selfridges; Louis Vuitton Mini Bumbag listed.

name: Hydration pack
definition: pack sold with its bag that carries a drink reservoir with a drinking tube.
notes: Running hydration packs and vests sold with reservoir or bottles; Decathlon hydration category.

name: Chalk bag
definition: small pouch worn at the waist to hold climbing chalk.
notes: Climbing chalk bags with webbing belt and drawstring sold as a category.

name: Quiver
definition: case worn on the body to carry arrows.
notes: Hip (side) quivers and back quivers sold as a category.

name: School satchel (rigid school backpack)
definition: backpack with a rigid or reinforced box-shaped body and frame, a padded back system and reflective panels, made for a schoolchild to carry books and sold as its own category.
notes: Randoseru rigid box-shaped school backpack; Markenkoffer sells Schulranzen as its own category.

name: Suitcase
definition: rigid or semi-rigid case with a lid for carrying clothes on a journey, usually on wheels with a telescoping handle.
notes: Samsonite carry-on, checked, hardside, softside; Rimowa cabin, check-in, trunk suitcases.

name: Travel trunk
definition: large box-shaped case made to travel with its owner.
notes: Rimowa sells Trunk, Trunk S, Trunk Plus, Trunk XL; Wikipedia defines trunk as large box.

name: Wheeled duffel
definition: duffel bag on a wheeled frame with a telescoping handle.
notes: Samsonite Wheeled Duffels category; Detour 29 inch Wheeled Duffel.

name: Duffel bag
definition: soft, roughly cylindrical bag with a long top opening and carry handles.
notes: Rimowa Duffle Bags category; Wikipedia: barrel-shaped soft-sided bag.

name: Garment bag
definition: bag that carries clothes on hangers, folded once or hung.
notes: Garment Bags category at Samsonite and Rimowa; Wikipedia: folds over so suits pack flat.

name: Dry bag
definition: waterproof roll-top bag that keeps its contents dry.
notes: Sea to Summit Big River Dry Bag, roll-top, 420D waterproof nylon.

name: Briefcase
definition: flat case with a handle for carrying papers and work items.
notes: Rimowa Briefcases category; Tumi briefcases listed under bags.

name: Attaché case
definition: hard-sided, box-shaped briefcase with a hinged lid.
notes: Attache case listings (Mark Cross, MOMODESIGN); Rimowa Attache aluminium briefcase.

name: Pilot case
definition: deep, box-shaped hard case with a top opening and a handle.
notes: Pilot cases and business trolleys sold together; Rimowa Original Pilot has top opening.

name: Bifold wallet
definition: wallet folded once, with card slots and a note section.
notes: Bi-fold wallet: notes folded once; Leatherology Bifold Wallet.

name: Trifold wallet
definition: wallet folded twice into three panels.
notes: Tri-fold wallet with two folds; Leatherology Trifold Wallet.

name: Long (continental) wallet
definition: long flat wallet that holds notes unfolded.
notes: Louis Vuitton Long and Continental Wallets; Hermes long wallets filter.

name: Zip-around wallet
definition: wallet closed by a zip running round three sides.
notes: Zip-around wallet sealed by perimeter zipper; Louis Vuitton Zippy Wallet is a named form.

name: Cardholder
definition: slim holder with card slots and no note section.
notes: Louis Vuitton Card and Key Holders; Leatherology slim wallet / cardholder.

name: Money clip
definition: clip that holds folded notes, sometimes with card slots.
notes: Money clip with spring-loaded or magnetic clip, no fold.

name: Coin purse
definition: small pouch or purse for coins.
notes: Louis Vuitton Rosalie Coin Purse; Hermes change purses.

name: Key pouch
definition: small pouch holding keys, usually on an inner ring or hooks.
notes: Louis Vuitton Key Pouch and Key Pouch S; keychain functionality.

name: Passport cover
definition: cover or wallet made to hold a passport.
notes: Louis Vuitton Passport Covers category; Leatherology passport holders.

name: Wallet on chain
definition: small bag-like wallet carried on a shoulder or cross-body chain (homonym with A4.5.11).
notes: Louis Vuitton Nano Bags and Chain Wallets; Wallet On Chain Ivy, shoulder or crossbody wear.

name: Chain wallet
definition: wallet fixed by a chain to a belt loop.
notes: Chain wallet tethered to belt loop by metal chain or leather cord.

name: Wristlet wallet
definition: wallet with a wrist strap, card slots inside and no separate interior compartment (homonym with A4.1.03).
notes: Wikipedia Wallet lists wristlet attached to the wrist; card slots not described.

name: Aviator
definition: teardrop-shaped frame with a double or triple bridge.
notes: Aviator: teardrop lenses, double bridge; Ray-Ban Aviator Classic.

name: Wayfarer-style
definition: trapezoidal frame, wider at the top, usually in thick plastic.
notes: Wayfarer: pointed outward corners; Ray-Ban Original and New Wayfarer.

name: Browline
definition: frame with a bold upper rim and a thin or rimless lower part.
notes: Clubmaster browline: thick upper browline, slim metal outline; Ray-Ban Clubmaster Classic.

name: Round
definition: frame with circular lenses.
notes: Round: circular lenses; one of the earliest sunglasses designs.

name: Cat-eye
definition: frame that sweeps upward at the outer top corners.
notes: Cat-eye: upswept corners.

name: Square
definition: frame with square or rectangular lenses.
notes: Square: angular frames even on all sides.

name: Geometric (hexagonal)
definition: frame with angular, many-sided lenses.
notes: Geometric incl. hexagonal and octagonal; Visiofactory hexagonal sunglasses category (137 references).

name: Compact (folding) umbrella
definition: umbrella whose shaft and ribs collapse to a short length.
notes: Compact or folding umbrella folds to fit a bag.

name: Stick umbrella
definition: umbrella with a fixed full-length shaft, often with a crook handle.
notes: Stick umbrella does not fold; bigger canopy.

name: Golf umbrella
definition: large stick umbrella with a wide canopy.
notes: Golf umbrella largest carried type, big enough for two.

name: Bubble umbrella
definition: umbrella with a deep dome-shaped clear canopy.
notes: Bubble or dome umbrella, deep usually clear canopy; totes Clear Bubble Umbrella.

name: Folding fan
definition: hand fan of ribs and leaf that folds closed.
notes: Folding fans: sensu, zheshan, brise fan.

name: Rigid fan
definition: hand fan with a fixed flat leaf on a handle.
notes: Fixed or rigid fans: uchiwa, tuanshan, screen fan.

name: Soft structured baby carrier
definition: buckled carrier with a padded panel, shoulder straps and waistband.
notes: Soft structured carrier: padded straps, waistband, structured panel, buckles.

name: Woven wrap
definition: long length of woven, non-stretch fabric tied round the wearer to hold a baby.
notes: Woven wraps: non-stretch fabric, tied round the body.

name: Stretchy wrap
definition: long length of stretch fabric tied round the wearer to hold a baby.
notes: Stretchy wraps: soft knit fabric, tied; newborn use.

name: Ring sling
definition: length of fabric threaded through two rings and worn over one shoulder.
notes: Ring sling: fabric threaded through two rings, single shoulder.

name: Mei tai
definition: panel carrier with four straps that are tied rather than buckled.
notes: Mei tai: fabric panel with straps that tie round waist and shoulders.

name: Hip seat
definition: waist belt with a seat on which a child sits on the wearer's hip.
notes: Hip seats: seat attachments on the hip; not full carriers.

name: Keyring
definition: ring or clip that holds keys and is carried on the person.
notes: Tiffany key rings; Markenkoffer sells key chains and key cases.

name: Fashion cane
definition: cane carried as a dress accessory, not as a mobility aid.
notes: Fashionable Canes sells dress, formal and designer canes distinct from comfort canes.

name: Shopping trolley
definition: wheeled bag on a frame with a handle, pulled to carry shopping.
notes: reisenthel foldabletrolley and carrycruiser shopping trolleys.

name: Luggage scale
definition: hand-held scale for weighing a packed bag.
notes: Hand-held digital luggage scale weighing to 50 kg; Weigh To Go tag with scale.

name: Holster
definition: case worn on the body to carry a handgun.
notes: Blade-Tech handgun holsters: inside and outside waistband types.

name: Bag charm
definition: decorative pendant made to hang on a bag, sold apart from keyrings.
notes: Fendi Bag Bugs sold as bag charms, an entire category of luxury products.

name: Bag strap
definition: separate shoulder or crossbody strap made to attach to a bag.
notes: Rimowa Bag Straps: replacement cross-body straps, detachable, leather or nylon.

name: Bag organiser insert
definition: insert with pockets and dividers placed inside a bag to arrange its contents.
notes: LAVA Purse Organizer Insert for handbags, nylon, fits Neverfull and Speedy.
